speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Anne. The hay is in, and light. The barley stands short. The house is busy with all of it.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: Light hay is a true sentence to carry. I saw the fields from the road. I am not adding to her.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Hamnet has found a jay's feather by the Guild Pits, and he will not say where.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: A boy with a feather is a boy with a secret. I was not there to ask him.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Judith has a third ballad by ear. Susanna writes on her own half-sheet.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You wrote who and it should be whom. Master Aspinall says so.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: A schoolmaster, in a daughter's hand. Your shoulders are laughing, if the rest of you will not.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A queen would hear the gardeners only if she hid. For servants say everything, but not to your face.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: I will not ask which queen. The packet is the packet. The horses are still my work.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nothing to send but a line of thanks. The Midsummer money went in June. I am not putting a day on the line.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: A line with no day rides as well as a letter with one. Put it in my hand before I am saddled, or not at all.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You shall have it. It will not be the sheet on my nail. That one is still not going.
